name: Coin and Money Shop
goal: Pay the exact price with coins and notes, then give the right change.
howToWin: Serve all 8 customers in a day. Paying exactly is best; there is no way to lose.
ruleVariant: Whole rupees only. The till holds up to 12 pieces. On the Coins and Notes levels paying too much is allowed and Gilu hands back change; on the Change level too much change is refused.
about: Practise making an exact amount of money and giving change, one customer at a time.
